diameterInterpretation: Convex lightcurve reconstruction at approximate thermal scale: 17.98 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.34 km; additional model uncertainty). Grid marks unavailable imagery; pole ambiguity is retained in source notes.

calibration.diameterSemantics: AKARI effective diameter transferred as an explicit approximate volume scale
calibration.limitations: AKARI fitted nonrotating-sphere effective diameter is transferred as a uniform volume-scale approximation to this independently obtained shape model. Kemi has one catalog detection; this limited measurement support remains explicit.
